notes.title: Disable Ultraleap's implicit OpenXR layer for desk use
notes.text: The Ultraleap installer registers XR_APILAYER_ULTRALEAP_hand_tracking as an implicit OpenXR API layer. The loader puts it in every OpenXR app, whichever runtime is active, and each load resets the tracking service to Head-mounted mode: with the camera on the desk the hands come back left/right swapped and sideways motion reads as depth. Set DISABLE_XR_APILAYER_ULTRALEAP_HAND_TRACKING_1=1 in the user environment, close every OpenXR app, then select Desktop mode again in the Ultraleap Control Panel.
notes.action: advise only - never change the layer's registration or the environment on the user's behalf

notes.title: LeapC.dll is not shipped
notes.text: The Windows installer copies LeapC.dll from the user's own Ultraleap install next to the provider (so another LeapC.dll on PATH cannot shadow it). After updating the Ultraleap software, re-run the provider installer to refresh that copy.
